scope.name: POSITIVE_GUARANTEED_EVALUABLE_POOL
scope.definition: At least one DIRECT_OBJECT_SUPPORT or WEAK_PROXY_SUPPORT hazard atom per image, by approved D6 pool membership.
scope.verification: Approved D6/census documentary verification; no new census or dataset execution.
scope.limit: Guarantees supported atoms under the operational taxonomy, not full hazard rationale truth or model success.

absence.future_d5: Grounding failure / zero matched evidence for an executed eligible positive sample; no rescue. No production D5 executor implemented here; NOT_PARTICIPATING models are not scored as failures.
mandatory_again_if_expanded_to: Object Hallucination Rate across the dataset

production_compatibility.query_policy: Same complete ordered 12-label set for all 982 images; independent of per-image GT and Call 1.
production_compatibility.qwen3: one image -> fixed all-12 prompt -> JSON detections -> exact label-to-hazard binding -> D4 xyxy /1000
production_compatibility.paligemma: one image -> detect obj1 ; ... ; obj12 -> loc detections -> exact label-to-hazard binding -> D4 yxyx /1024
production_compatibility.moondream: UNCHANGED; native single-object detect may need backend fan-out; G3 provides no authority or implementation for it.
production_compatibility.scoring: D5 UNCHANGED; separate RQ3-A Direct and RQ3-B Weak Proxy; unsupported spatial atoms excluded. All 12 are still queried, including DOOR_OPEN. No full-dataset Object Hallucination Rate.

qwen3.prompt_template: Locate every instance that belongs to the following categories: '{obj_names}'. Report bbox coordinates in JSON format.

randomness: GREEDY_NO_SAMPLING; no claim of cross-device bitwise determinism
pass_requires_all: All 12 positive cases have >=1 expected queried target and the identical ordered full four-label query set; one native prompt/call per case.
One pinned model load; every required call completes with EOS, no missing/duplicate/extra calls or truncation.
Raw envelope and preparse provenance persisted exclusively, fsynced, reread and SHA256/size verified BEFORE parsing; final artifact audit complete.
No runtime, storage, provenance, token-boundary or identity error.
Same pinned prompt/parser/config throughout the run; every response SUCCESS with exact native queried labels; unknown labels or one malformed detection invalidate the whole response.
Exactly the expected predicted count for EACH queried label, including ZERO for queried-but-absent labels.
Every expected instance has one same-label prediction whose center is inside its GT box (boundary included); every prediction uniquely assigned; one-to-one within each label.
Every prediction excludes every unqueried distractor center; an unqueried distractor must not be detected as a queried category.
All four reciprocal pairs A/B/C/D pass geometry and prediction-center displacement has the same strict sign as target displacement on each moved axis.
F_two_red and G_multi preserve every instance and label; no dropped or deduplicated detection.
No exact full-image box; explicit human NO_GIANT review of ALL detections with reviewer and rationale per case.
Entire empty response on any case is POSITIVE_GUARANTEE_MISS and FAIL, never valid absence.
All pre-execution hashes and controls match; no retry/repair/alternate prompt/parser modification/GT-selected query.

verdict_contract.BLOCKED: Runtime integration or execution authority missing; no execution.
verdict_contract.FAIL: Any mandatory check fails; no partial PASS.
verdict_contract.PENDING_REVIEW: All automated checks pass but human NO_GIANT reviews incomplete.
verdict_contract.PASS: All checks and human reviews pass; still requires separate Research Lead promotion decision.

raw_audit_contract.raw_failure: Stop; never invoke parser. Preserve any available partial native output and record failure; never fabricate unavailable bytes.

future_runtime_contract.environment_lock: Before execution record exact Python, torch/CUDA, transformers, tokenizers, Pillow, model/processor snapshot hashes, hardware and native adapter source hashes; approve independently before loading.
future_runtime_contract.historical_runners: UNCHANGED; neither historical runner may consume this plan. New runtime integration must verify full query prompt, continuation boundary, EOS and durable raw-before-parse.
future_runtime_contract.budget_basis: Prospectively fixed 512-token synthetic ceiling per model for up to five detections, before model outputs. No in-run increase. Production all-12 context/token budget requires separate pre-execution freeze and qualification; synthetic PASS is not production execution authority.

synthetic_generation.regeneration: Byte-exact within pinned generator environment; CLI verifies checked-in manifest and never overwrites mismatching images.
